issues: Swapped/misattributed baseline in result: the brief states 'RDMA下KV检索TTFT较Mooncake降60到87.5%且基本持平', which attributes the 60-87.5% TTFT reduction as being relative to Mooncake. Per the source evidence (Section 6.3, Fig 8), the 60-87.5% TTFT reduction is an absolute reduction measured for N-1 instances relative to the first instance (no-cache baseline), and TensorCast achieves a level comparable to Mooncake. The phrasing is also internally contradictory (a 60-87.5% drop vs Mooncake would not be 'on par'). The reduction is not relative to Mooncake; both systems achieve comparable absolute reductions under RDMA.

Minimal correction: change result from 'RDMA下KV检索TTFT较Mooncake降60到87.5%且基本持平，非RDMA场景明显更优。' to 'RDMA下KV检索TTFT降60到87.5%与Mooncake持平，非RDMA场景明显更优。' — removing the incorrect '较Mooncake' attribution of the reduction percentage.
